candidate_decisions.master_monday_note: Remain in shadow. Stable, inexpensive runs do not yet satisfy the incremental-protection promotion gate.
candidate_decisions.rationale: The preregistered gate requires repeated stable runs plus real defect discovery or mutation protection not already provided by baseline. The latter has not been demonstrated; repeated observations of one target version do not establish performance across real changes.
candidate_decisions.rollback_path: Delete the isolated property probe and its workflow reference; no canonical, market, or portfolio rollback is required.
